jobs.title: Manager, Cyber Security Culture & Skill
jobs.description:
About the Role

This role is responsible for building and strengthening the organization's cybersecurity culture through awareness programs, training, engagement initiatives, and capability development. The position combines security awareness, learning administration, phishing simulation management, and employee capability development to ensure that security becomes a shared responsibility across the business.

Responsibilities

Security Awareness Campaigns
• Design, plan and deliver end-to-end security awareness campaigns across the organisation, covering relevant cybersecurity topics and relevant risks for example Artificial Intelligence.
• Manage the annual awareness calendar, ensuring campaigns are timely, relevant and aligned to the organisation's current risk landscape.
• Develop or coordinate with supplier to deliver engaging, audience-appropriate content across multiple formats (e-learning, video, intranet, posters, newsletters, toolkits).
• Coordinate with Internal Communications, central functions and business unit partners to maximise campaign reach and effectiveness.
• Track and report on campaign engagement metrics and outcomes.

CCN (Cyber Champions Network) Ownership & Orchestration
• Own and run the Cyber Champions Network (CCN) across the group, acting as the primary point of contact for Champions across markets, business units and functions.
• Coordinate regular CCN communications, meetings and events to keep Champions engaged and informed.
• Develop toolkits, guides and resources to enable Champions to drive local security culture initiatives.
• Monitor CCN health and participation, and develop strategies to grow and sustain the network.

Phishing Simulations
• Design and execute phishing simulation campaigns using the organisation's chosen platform, ensuring scenarios are realistic, varied and progressively challenging.
• Analyse simulation results, identify trends and at-risk populations, and develop targeted follow-up interventions.
• Produce clear, actionable reporting on phishing simulation outcomes for GRC leadership and relevant business stakeholders.

LMS Administration & Support
• Administer the organisation's Learning Management System (LMS), including user management, content uploads, course assignments and completion tracking.
• Ensure mandatory security training is assigned, tracked and completed within required timeframes across all relevant populations.
• Troubleshoot LMS issues and liaise with the LMS team or internal IT teams as required.
• Maintain accurate training completion records and produce compliance reporting.

SRC Skills Matrix & Learning Paths
• Develop and maintain the SRC skills matrix, mapping required competencies across GRC, security operations, risk management and compliance disciplines.
• Design role-appropriate learning paths for SRC team members and, where relevant, for the broader IT and business community.
• Identify skills gaps within the SRC team and recommend targeted development interventions.
• Keep learning paths current by monitoring evolving industry certifications, frameworks and skill requirements.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Experience
• 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, GRC, or IT Risk, with a focus on or strong interest in security awareness, culture and capability development.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and delivering security awareness programmes or campaigns.
• Experience administering or working within an LMS platform (e.g. LearnUpon, Proofpoint, or similar).
• Practical experience running phishing simulation programmes.
• Familiarity with security awareness frameworks and best practices (e.g. SANS Security Awareness, NIST SP 800-50, ISO 27001 Annex A.7.2.2).
• Strong written communication and content creation skills.
• Experience working cross-functionally with HR and Communications teams advantageous.

Required Skills

Key Competencies
• Execution-focused with strong delivery discipline and attention to detail.
• Creative communicator with the ability to make security topics engaging and accessible to non-technical audiences.
• Organised and structured, able to manage multiple concurrent campaigns and workstreams.
• Collaborative and relationship-oriented, with the ability to work effectively with a distributed network of Champions and cross-functional partners.
• Data-driven approach to measuring programme effectiveness and driving continuous improvement.
• Self-sufficient and proactive - comfortable operating with a degree of autonomy and minimal supervision.
• Genuine passion for building security culture and developing people's security capabilities.

jobs.title: Co-Lead – Digital Infrastructure & Cyber Security
jobs.description:
Job Description: Co-Lead – Digital Infrastructure & Cyber Security

Role: Co-Lead (Digital Infrastructure & Cyber Security)

Mapped Domain: Cyber Security, Cloud Security & Digital Infrastructure Security

Reporting to: Vice President / Head of Vertical, NeGD, Digital India Corporation

Location: New Delhi, India

About the Role

NeGD is looking for an experienced cyber security professional to serve as Co-Lead – Digital Infrastructure &

Cyber Security. Working alongside the Practice Lead, the Co-Lead will help strengthen the cyber security posture

of government digital platforms and infrastructure, advise Central Ministries and States/UTs on secure cloud and

infrastructure adoption, lead cyber security capacity building initiatives for government officials, and support the

growth of NeGD's advisory engagements in this area.

Roles & Responsibilities

•Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure Modernization: Advise Ministries, Departments and States/UTs on

cyber security policies, frameworks, audits and incident response, in line with CERT-In and MeitY guidelines.

•Secure Cloud & Infrastructure: Support secure adoption of MeitY-empanelled cloud and government data

centre infrastructure, including DR/BCP planning.

•Business Development: Facilitate new engagements with existing and new Ministries, Departments and

States/UTs for NeGD's cyber security and infrastructure advisory services.

•Technical Appraisal: Review DPRs, infrastructure proposals and security architectures submitted by

Departments.

•Procurement Support: Help draft RFPs, technical specifications and SLAs for security and infrastructure

services such as SOC, VAPT and cloud hosting.

•Capacity Building: Plan and run cyber security capacity building initiatives for government, including the

CISO Deep Dive trainings, cyber security courses on iGOT Karmayogi, and workshops, table-top exercises and

cyber drills for CISOs, Deputy CISOs, officials and technical teams of Central Ministries and States/UTs.

Develop training content, track participation and outcomes, and coordinate delivery with CERT-In, academia

and industry partners.

•Ecosystem Coordination: Work with CERT-In, NCIIPC, STQC, cloud service providers and industry partners.

Eligibility Criteria

•Educational Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology,

Cyber Security, Electronics & Communication or a related discipline. A post-graduate degree is desirable but

not mandatory.

•Total Work Experience: Minimum 10 years of experience in IT / digital infrastructure and cyber security,

including at least 5 years in cyber security.

•Specialized Experience:

oHands-on experience in one or more of: security architecture, SOC operations, VAPT / security audits,

incident response or cloud security.

oExperience of working with Government, PSUs or large enterprises is desirable. Experience in designing or

delivering cyber security training and capacity building programmes is an added advantage.

•Desired Certifications: Preferred, not mandatory – CISSP, CISM, CEH, CCSP or an equivalent cloud security

certification.

Skills & Attributes

•Good understanding of cloud, data centre and network security.

•Working knowledge of the IT Act, DPDP Act, CERT-In directions and CII/NCIIPC norms.

•Good communication, documentation and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work with senior government officials and multi-disciplinary teams.

jobs.title: Hacker-Application Penetration Testing
jobs.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Security Penetration Tester, you will assess the IT security risk of an organization by attempting to breach security systems, identifying weaknesses, and determining how to improve enterprise information security. You will contribute to the design, development, and implementation of countermeasures, system integration, and tools specific to Cyber and Information Operations.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

• Evaluate System Security: Evaluate system security configurations, perform analysis of complex software systems to determine functionality and intent, and identify weaknesses in security systems.
• Conduct Penetration Testing: Attempt to hack into networks to access information without authorization, documenting and analyzing findings to determine root causes and recommend countermeasures.
• Develop and Implement Countermeasures: Contribute to the design, development, and implementation of countermeasures, system integration, and tools specific to Cyber and Information Operations.
• Prepare Technical Reports: Prepare and present technical reports and briefings to Technical and Executive teams, detailing attempts, conclusions, and recommended countermeasures.
• Analyze Client Environment: Analyze client business and security environment, conduct in-depth analysis of problem areas, and develop proposals to address these areas.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

• Exposure to Security Systems Analysis: Experience working with system security configurations, evaluating findings, and performing root cause analysis to identify weaknesses in security systems.
• Complex Software Systems Analysis: Exposure to analysis of complex software systems to determine both functionality and intent of software systems.
• Penetration Testing Methodologies: Experience working with penetration testing methodologies, including attempting to hack into networks to access information without authorization.
• Countermeasure Development: Exposure to the design, development, and implementation of countermeasures, system integration, and tools specific to Cyber and Information Operations.
• Technical Reporting: Experience preparing and presenting technical reports and briefings to Technical and Executive teams, detailing attempts, conclusions, and recommended countermeasures.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

• Reverse Engineering Skills: Exposure to reverse engineering techniques to analyze and understand software systems, identifying potential vulnerabilities and weaknesses. Ability to vet and weaponize identified vulnerabilities through reverse engineering.
• Mainframe Application Knowledge: Experience working with mainframe applications, understanding their security configurations and potential weaknesses, and developing strategies to improve their security posture.
• Cybersecurity Tools Familiarity: Exposure to various cybersecurity tools and technologies, including those used for penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, and countermeasure development.

jobs.title: Sr Advanced Cyb Sec Archt/Engr
jobs.description:
Qualifications

Sr Advanced Cyber Security Architect/Engineer - Product Security

As a Sr Advanced Cyber Security Architect/Engineer - Product Security here at Honeywell Global Security, you will play a critical role in ensuring the security of our industrial automation products. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to assess security risks, develop security architectures, and implement security controls for our products. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies and contribute to the overall product security strategy of the company. You will report directly to our Cyber Security Manager and you'll work out of our Bangalore, India location on a Hybrid work schedule. In this role, you will impact the security of our industrial automation products by designing and implementing robust product security solutions. You will be responsible for identifying vulnerabilities, conducting risk assessments, and implementing security controls to protect our products and ensure the safety and reliability of our customers' operations.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and implement product security solutions for industrial automation products
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to assess security risks and develop security architectures
• Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing for our products
• Implement security controls to protect our products and ensure their safety and reliability
• Stay up-to-date with the latest product security trends and technologies

YOU MUST HAVE

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
• Minimum 7 years of experience in cyber security or related roles
• Strong knowledge of product security principles, technologies, and best practices
• Experience with vulnerability assessments and penetration testing for industrial automation products
• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities

WE VALUE

• Batchelor’s degree in Cyber Security or a related field
• Industry-recognized certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, CISM, or CEH
• Experience with secure coding practices and secure software development lifecycle
• Knowledge of industrial automation protocols and standards (e.g., OPC, Modbus, IEC 62443)
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer – Cybersecurity Platform

Location: Abu Dhabi — Remote

Employment type: Full-time

Company: QuantumGenie, Inc.

About QuantumGenie

QuantumGenie is a post-quantum cryptography and cybersecurity company building products for cryptographic discovery, inventory, dependency mapping, risk assessment, crypto-agility planning, and migration to quantum-safe systems.

Our platform identifies cryptography across source code, cloud infrastructure, databases, certificates, endpoints, and enterprise systems. It converts evidence into a Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM), discovery records, asset inventories, and relationship maps for remediation and migration planning.

We are hiring a hands-on engineer in India to maintain and improve the complete platform: application code, integrations, data models, tests, deployments, documentation, and endpoint-agent releases.

Early-career candidates with strong practical ability are welcome. We value demonstrated ownership, technical judgment, learning speed, and careful execution over pedigree.

What you will own
• Maintain and extend a production Node.js and Express application written primarily in JavaScript, with newer TypeScript and React interfaces.
• Diagnose problems across frontend pages, backend services, APIs, authentication, scheduled jobs, data pipelines, and MongoDB.
• Maintain integrations with cloud, source-control, database, endpoint-security, PKI, and observability platforms.
• Work with REST APIs, OAuth, access tokens, webhooks, SDKs, pagination, rate limits, retries, background jobs, and least-privilege permissions.
• Improve schemas supporting assets, agents, discovery runs, evidence, CBOM records, relationships, connectors, releases, and tenant-scoped data.
• Maintain workflows for connecting systems, running scans, reviewing findings, and exporting results.
• Support our Go endpoint agent and its Linux and Windows releases, including services, registration, telemetry, discovery, signed updates, and rollback.
• Troubleshoot Linux, Windows Server, cloud, proxy, firewall, DNS, TLS, private-CA, and MongoDB connectivity issues.
• Write and maintain unit, integration, and browser tests using Node’s test runner, Vitest, Playwright, and Testing Library.
• Take production issues from logs and reproduction through root cause, controlled fix, verification, and documentation.
• Turn customer and pilot requirements into small, reviewable improvements with the founders.

Core technical requirements

We expect practical proficiency in most of the following:
• JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js, including asynchronous programming, APIs, validation, error handling, and production debugging.
• Express or a comparable backend framework, including routing, middleware, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and secure API design.
• React, HTML, CSS, Vite, responsive interfaces, and component-level testing.
• MongoDB, including document modelling, indexes, aggregation, migrations, tenant-scoped queries, performance analysis, and safe production changes.
• Git and GitHub workflows: branches, pull requests, code review, merge-conflict resolution, release tagging, and repository hygiene.
• Automated testing: reproducing defects, choosing meaningful tests, and proving that fixes work.
• Linux command-line administration and basic Windows/PowerShell familiarity.
• Cloud operations in at least one of AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or DigitalOcean. Experience with more than one is preferred.
• Containers, environment variables, secrets, logs, health checks, networking, DNS, TLS, and controlled releases.
• Secure third-party APIs: credentials, permissions, response normalization, retries, recovery, and auditability.
• Ability to safely navigate a mixed codebase containing JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Python, Bash, and PowerShell, even if JavaScript/TypeScript is your strongest area.

AI-assisted engineering

QuantumGenie uses AI coding agents. You must be comfortable with OpenAI Codex and similar cloud-based tools while retaining human ownership of every result.

You should be able to:
• Give an AI coding agent precise context, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
• Inspect repository instructions and architecture before changing code.
• Review generated code and diffs for correctness, security, maintainability, and unintended effects.
• Preserve unrelated work, protect credentials, and run appropriate tests and deployment validation.
• Recognize unsupported generated answers and verify them against source code, logs, documentation, or a controlled test.

Google Cloud Code, cloud CLI, or remote-development experience is useful. Prompting alone is insufficient; sound engineering fundamentals are required.

Cybersecurity and infrastructure knowledge

You do not need to be a cryptographer on day one, but you must be interested in cybersecurity and willing to learn post-quantum cryptography. Familiarity with any of the following is valuable:
• TLS, HTTPS, certificates, certificate chains, certificate authorities, public/private keys, key rotation, PKI, KMS, HSMs, and secrets management.
• RSA, ECC, ECDSA, AES, SHA, SSH, IPsec, and modern post-quantum standards.
• Servers, VMs, endpoints, containers, APIs, databases, DNS, proxies, firewalls, gateways, load balancers, and cloud relationships.
• Source-code and dependency scanning, SBOM/CBOM concepts, CycloneDX, evidence provenance, and security findings.
• Endpoint telemetry, filesystem scanning, operating-system services, network connections, and the distinction between connection metadata and packet capture.
• Enterprise identity, least privilege, role-based access control, tenant isolation, audit logging, and secure credential handling.
• Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike Falcon, Qualys, Palo Alto Cortex, Splunk, ServiceNow, or comparable enterprise platforms.

Enterprise software, banking technology, cloud security, security operations, PKI, or infrastructure experience is strongly preferred.

Endpoint and release engineering

The platform includes a Go endpoint agent. Go experience is helpful, but willingness to learn is acceptable.

Relevant experience includes:
• Linux systemd and Windows services.
• MSI, ZIP, RPM, and tar.gz packaging.
• Bash and PowerShell.
• SHA-256 checksums and code signing.
• Secure device enrollment and identity.
• Telemetry protocols.
• Remote software updates and rollback.
• Testing on Linux and Windows virtual machines.

What good performance looks like
• You take problems from reproduction through root cause, implementation, testing, documentation, and release.
• You distinguish customer data from demonstration data and prevent information from crossing tenant boundaries.
• You make small, reviewable changes and explain their operational impact.
• You verify claims by reading code and running the system rather than relying on assumptions.
• You protect secrets and keep schemas, release records, and operational documentation current.
• You communicate early when a requested capability is a prototype, partially implemented, or dependent on customer access.

Preferred background
• Approximately 2–5 years in software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, cloud, or cybersecurity. Strong candidates outside this range are welcome.
• A degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Evidence of maintaining a real application, service, integration, or customer deployment.
• Multi-tenant SaaS or regulated-industry experience.
• Clear written English for technical documentation and customer communication.

Personal qualities
• Curious about cybersecurity, cryptography, infrastructure, and how complex enterprise systems fit together.
• Enthusiastic about learning post-quantum cryptography and contributing to an emerging field.
• Reliable, methodical, and comfortable taking ownership in a remote environment.
• Able to work independently while raising risks and uncertainty promptly.
• Honest about what is implemented, what has been tested, and what remains to be built.

What we offer
• Fully remote work from India.
• Direct founder collaboration and ownership of a live cybersecurity platform.
• Exposure to post-quantum cryptography, CBOM, cloud security, endpoint engineering, and enterprise integrations.
• Work spanning product engineering, infrastructure, security, and customer pilots.
• Strong learning opportunities as post-quantum security evolves.

jobs.title: Incident Response Consultant, Mandiant
jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:

In-office locations: Dubai - United Arab Emirates.

Remote location(s): United Arab Emirates; Qatar.Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 5 years of experience working end to end incident response investigations, analysis, or containment actions.
• 5 years of investigative experience with network forensics, malware triage analysis, cloud forensics, or disk and memory forensics.
• Ability to travel up to 30%.

Preferred qualifications:

• Certifications in cloud platforms and GCFA, GCFE, GNFA, GCIA, GREM, GCIH, or GX-FA.
• Experience in time management to balance multiple tasks and mentor other consultants as needed.
• Experience in security competitions, Capture the Flags, or testing platforms such as Hack the Box, TryHackMe, and Overthewire.
• Experience communicating investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, legal counsel, and clients.

About The Job

As an Incident Response Consultant, you will provide industry-leading incident response, assessment, transformation, managed detection and response, and training services with in-depth tactical support. You will help organizations effectively detect and respond to threats and reduce the overall impact of business risk before, during, and after an incident. You will be able to resolve security incidents quickly, effectively and at scale with complete incident response including investigation, containment, remediation, and crisis management. In this role, you will work on engagements including assisting clients in navigating technically complex and high-profile incidents, performing forensic analysis, threat hunting, and malware triage.

Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.

Responsibilities

• Lead large, client-facing incident response engagements, examine cloud, endpoint, and network-based sources of evidence.
• Conduct host forensics, network forensics, log analysis, and malware triage in support of incident response investigations.
• Recognize and codify attacker Tools, Tactics, and Procedures (TTPs) and Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) that can be applied to current and future investigations.
• Develop and present comprehensive and accurate reports, trainings, and presentations for both technical and executive audiences.
• Build scripts, tools, or methodologies to enhance Mandiant’s incident investigation processes.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law.
